description: This PHP class 'FormatWithEducation' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides functionality to format a value by retrieving an education name using an education ID. It interacts with the 'EducationService' to fetch education details and returns the education name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithEducation
classes.description: A class that formats an education entity value into its name by retrieving education information from the EducationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the education name corresponding to a given education ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of EducationService.
